institution: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

app_fee.value: NTNU's PhD admission pages state no application fee; the fees they mention are semester and tuition fees.

fee_waiver.value: No fee waiver for PhD applicants is stated on NTNU's PhD admission pages.

gre_general.value: No GRE requirement is stated on NTNU's PhD admission pages.

toefl_min.value: NTNU's PhD pages give no TOEFL score; the general language page (TOEFL 90) covers study programmes and courses and is not stated to cover PhD admission.

ielts_min.value: NTNU's PhD pages give no IELTS score; the general language page (IELTS 6.5) is not stated to cover PhD admission.

english_waiver.value: NTNU's PhD pages state no English test rule, so no India or English-medium waiver can be confirmed.

notes: PhD admission is handled by each faculty (Natural Sciences, Engineering, IE, Medicine and Health Sciences). Official PhD programme list used: faculty pages https://www.ntnu.edu/nv/phd , https://www.ntnu.edu/ie/research/phd , https://www.ntnu.edu/iv/doctoral-programme , https://www.ntnu.edu/mh/phd . The all-programmes list (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/allstudies?city=&studyLevel=980&field=&query=&open=true&taughtInEnglish=true) is rendered by script and returned no programme list. 404 (not used): https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phelt and https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phdis/admission. Older PHMED page https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phmed is replaced by PHMEDHV, so it is not used. Regulation PDFs dated 2020 are not used (older than five years). Language page https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/langcourses/languagerequirements covers master's and exchange admission, not PhD admission. Not separate records: PhD in Electric Power Engineering (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phelkt), PhD in Biotechnology (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phbiot), PhD in Biophysics (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phbify), PhD in Nautical Operations (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phnaut). No PhD found for astronomy (physics research lists Physics and Biophysics only) or environment (Industrial Ecology offers PhD courses, not a programme). Data science has no own track.
